objective: Add the actual pinned Node browser worker and reproducible P3 runtime bundle. Extend the selected automation_host with an exact browser automation dependency and lock, implement a probe worker that launches only the supplied bundled Chromium executable, stage Node + automation host + browser payload into browser-runtime-manifest.v1.json with exact file/tree/package-lock identities, and prove clean-machine launch/stop without global Node or network browser installation. Preserve the P3-001 parent protocol and do not implement P3-002 session semantics. The workflow may also run the exact repository Dart formatter against parent-owned browser files as a read-only formatting oracle; it must not commit parent-path changes.
requiredTests: automation_host package and lock pin exact browser dependency version
browser worker launches only explicit --browser-executable and emits exact ready handshake
stage tool emits browser-runtime-manifest.v1.json matching parent resolver contract
staged bundle contains Node/browser worker/browser root/package lock and no network installer dependency
tri-platform clean-machine probe starts and stops bundled browser with no surviving descendant
